   **Bugs and stability.**

      Review window: Jun 27, 2026 - Sep 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Vanessalikescake_, Sep 13, 2026, 1/5: "Every time I do a workout it freezes and goes on a loop without finishing the workout routine. It’s frustrating and causing me to waste a lot of time."
            2. _Beef_Curtains_, Sep 13, 2026, 1/5: "When i synced it to my google health app it doubled all my steps and there was no fixing it. I tried for hours but its broken. Feels like i lost all my hard-work and data because of a dumb technical glitch."
            3. _SarahCelebrian_, Sep 2, 2026, 2/5: "I got a Fastest 5k award for a 3.5km run and according to the award I ran the 5k in 20 minutes which doesn’t match the workout so no idea where it’s coming from. This is annoying because now I can’t see my actual fastest time or when it was. Very disappointing that there’s no easy way to report bugs like this. I’d expected better from Apple"
